paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different consistency conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.5 to 10.0, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 25 to 33, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1.  A red dashed line with star markers represents “Consistency-Bi”, starting at approximately 28.7 BLEU at AL = 2.5, reaching 32.3 BLEU at AL = 10.0. A purple dashed line with square markers represents “Inconsistency-CE”, starting at approximately 26.5 BLEU at AL = 2.5, reaching 31.7 BLEU at AL = 10.0. A navy blue solid line with diamond markers represents “Inconsistency-CE-MP”, starting at approximately 26.5 BLEU at AL = 2.5, reaching 31.7 BLEU at AL = 10.0. A magenta solid line with plus markers represents “Consistency-CE”, starting at approximately 28.7 BLEU at AL = 2.5, reaching 32.2 BLEU at AL = 10.0.
